verdict.rationale: Reducto documents confidence scores on Parse output elements and per-criterion confidence on Classify. Extract supports bounding-box citations for tracing values back to source text, and Studio has a citation viewer, though it is described for testing workflows rather than reviewing fields. Nothing shows per-field confidence on Extract results, calibration of the scores, or a human-in-the-loop review path that routes low-confidence fields to reviewers. Missing for 10: per-field confidence on Extract outputs, evidence the scores are calibrated, a documented human review queue or escalation for low-confidence fields, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, extractions carry calibrated confidence scores with a human-in-the-loop review path for low-confidence fields

citations.quote: Each element includes its type, page position, and confidence score.
Classify returns a category label, a per-criterion confidence breakdown for every category in your schema, and timing information.
Citations tell you exactly where each extracted value came from in the document. When enabled, every field includes bounding box coordinates pointing to the source text.
